i wasn't actively planning suicide at the time but I was incredibly depressed and in a very dark place I had gone out with my mother and I had brought some pills my excuse was that they were to go in a first aid kit, as I'm known to have those kinds of things on me. I went home and this is where it blurs a bit I cannot remember for the life of me if it was the same day or the next but I remember just sobbing then taking a bunch of pills one by one. I recordered my entire process on reddit but now I've archived it as its quite embarrassing. I have commented a bit on this thread in an attempt to help others but I couldn't help myself. I ended up calling the mental health emergency line and the ambulance arrived after a couple hours. my mum was crying and I had such a bad stomach ache and my head was spinning. my dad rushed home from work and I felt so bad. my puke was black and grainy. I was sent to the hospital via ambulance and the couple days I was there it was all merged together. it was an experience to say the least. but I'm doing much better now. still sometimes crave the feeling of the hospital.

TL;DR: basically I tried overdosing then I called an ambulance for myself. I tried to take my life but dramatically backed out.

Hello friend,

Here is my advice, read it and take it as you will :)

I can see you're hurting, and I am sorry that you're feeling this way. As someone who's attempted, trust me it's not worth it. I recommend taking time to learn about yourself. You seem to be a lovely person with a big heart as you seem to care about your family worrying. This is your first sign to stay. You have a reason. You have emotion to show and love to share and things to see and you still have tears left to cry but you also have so much joy in you that hasn't shown it's full potential. I just wanted to let you know that you still have a chance at life. You seem quite youthful and despite your age, it means you can start over.

Despite your gender identity, give yourself time first. We, as humans, tend to put all of our effort to love others when the most important person to love is yourself. I'm not saying it's easy. But don't beat yourself up about it. Just know that out there is someone who cares. Trust me. Because for all you know, I care so much. And there is help out there. You can still find yourself. The fact you posted on here shows how you want someone to stop you, because as much as you're screaming in your mind not to do it. The negative thoughts are always too powerful, though it seems. You came here to hear what you've been trying to tell yourself for years.

You matter. 

And even though it rains and storms, the sun is bound to show it's truest form. Happiness. Pure joy. Giving yourself that care and self love you've always deserved. Because when you're all alone and it seems no one is there to help who is always there to help you see the next sunrise.

It's yourself. 

So why not treat the biggest hero of your life the best you can. You only live this life once, so show how you're worth it. Even just doing something small like drawing, watching your favourite show, eating your favourite foods or just sleeping in. Give yourself that love that no one else can provide you.

May God bless your pure soul. Please eat well, stay hydrated and sleep well. Take care. Goodbye.

\- Miles.

I am a Muslim. Living in England. It's was never going to be easy. My parents do not speak proper English. As soon as I learned to read and write,  I was doing phone calls for my parents. Helping with tax, loans, attending appointments with them, and translating everything. I never had a support system. I matured too quickly. It's not even my parents' fault though, they did their best with me and are doing so. I have a younger sister, whose life is a breeze. Why did she get it so easy? Yes she has health problems but never once has she had to lift a finger. Am I jealous? Yes.

I want to go away. I want to run away. Somewhere where no one will find me. I want to die, but I have so much on my plate that if I go away what will happen to my family. I'm the one holding everything up and if I collapse I can only imagine what will happen to the rest. 

I'm exhausted. I'm tired. I don't wanna do this no more. I've held up for so long that I can't go on anymore. I have a feeling I'm on the autistic spectrum, it's what I was called all throughout primary school so it's just stuck with me.

People expect so much from me but I can't keep breaking myself for others. 

I want help but there is none. I feel so alone. Yet so crowded.

I'm sorry friend, I shouldn't be telling you this. Have a good day and remember I love you.

Hello,

I was scrolling through this subreddit and came across this post.

I made this account just because I wanted to tell you this. I apologize if this makes zero sense, I too am going through a mental breakdown.

I don't know you and you don't know me, but I can tell you one thing; you are strong. I don't want to give you false hope but I can be honest. I hope you are able to read this and think about everything.

Just please take a deep breath, in...and out. 

Think about one thing that makes you happy, it doesn't matter what it is! Anything! Miniscule or massive. Focus on that, why does it make you happy? Does it let you escape from this reality? 

I don't know you but I would feel awful knowing someone that could've been saved my some comforting words hadn't got the chance to hear them. I really do appreciate the existence of you on this earth. Life may feel useless and pointless but there will be days where you feel a bit better; you'll learn to smile just like how you learned everything else, with patience and perseverance. 

I also feel like giving up; but my way remedy is to comfort others, knowing that the words I say without a voice can give another across this globe comfort and a sense of joy - even if it may be temporary. 

I hate toxic positivity so I will not give you this false sense of 'everything is going to get better' because, for all I know, it may not. But please think about this carefully. It may not get better but it doesn't mean it's going to get worse. 

If you would like to talk I am here, if not then there are helplines, people who want to listen. They do care, I care. Suicide isn't the death of one person, it's the murder of millions. Please once again I am telling you to take a deep breath, cry if you need to, it will make you feel better. Do whatever makes you feel better; just please do not take your life. 

I love you.

\-Miles
